# The Keyword

> Google's official blog covering AI innovation, product updates, and technology announcements with focus on Gemini, Google Cloud, and enterprise solutions.

The Keyword is Google's primary platform for sharing product launches, AI research breakthroughs, and technology news. It serves as the authoritative source for updates across Google's portfolio including Workspace, Maps, Cloud, and DeepMind initiatives.

## Key Topics

- Gemini
- Google DeepMind
- Google Cloud
- Google Workspace
- AI models
- Product announcements
- Google Maps
- Personal Intelligence
- Developer tools
- Search AI
- Project Genie
- Gemini expansion
- Health AI
- Prompt writing
- Enterprise solutions

## AI & Innovation

- [Innovation & AI](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai): Hub for Google's AI innovation, research, and quantum computing initiatives
- [Google DeepMind](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/google-deepmind): Google DeepMind research updates including Gemini 3 and Project Genie announcements

## Enterprise & Cloud

- [Google Cloud news and updates](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/infrastructure-and-cloud/google-cloud): Latest news and updates on Google Cloud infrastructure, AI tools, and enterprise solutions
- [News and updates on Google Workspace](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/products/workspace): Google Workspace news covering Gemini AI, productivity, and collaboration tool updates

## Products & Platforms

- [Products](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/products): Central hub for all Google product news covering Android, Chrome, and services
- [Official Google Maps news and updates](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/products/maps): Google Maps product updates featuring Immersive View and machine learning improvements
- [The latest updates on Google's learning and education initiatives](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/products/education): Google's education initiatives, AI learning tools, and classroom innovation updates

## News & Updates

- [The Keyword | Google Product and Technology News and Stories](https://blog.google): Google's official blog featuring product updates, AI announcements, and technology news
